## Ops | ILG stock report import (hourly)
HORIZON reads the newest **DOCKBAY Daily Stock Report** from **ops@** (Gmail connector, read only) and stores it once. ILG sends it once a day (~19:30 UK); this checks every hour at :07.
HORIZON ▸ Buy & Move ▸ Inventory ▸ Manage 3PL ▸ UK (ILG). Built by Claude for Ben, 28-Oct-26.
